preprocessing.downloaded_array: Original percent-transmission representation per data README; finite float32 (not LFS), 1868 ordered points. No wavenumber vector published with these arrays.
preprocessing.declared_runtime: percent transmission to absorbance; independent per-spectrum minmax; point-wise standardization using training fold only; UltraIR then resizes 1868 to1792. Traditional models need not resize.
preprocessing.target_scaling: Y files retain original LC-MS a.u.; normalize targets from training partition only when needed and invert for reported metrics.
preprocessing.augmentation: All four supplied task YAMLs set augment.enabled=false.
preprocessing.verification_limit: No attempt to prove upstream acquisition/preparation lacked all statistical dependence; current downstream transforms can be fitted on training only.

quality_findings.high_correlation_caveat: No pairs above0.99999 row correlation observed, but spectra naturally highly correlated; absence of exact duplicates does not establish independent physical samples.

scope_limits: FTIR benchmark, not THz, not Huangqi.
Row-stratified five-fold benchmark only; cannot claim unseen-batch or physical-group independence without IDs.
Regression target is relative abundance, not pharmacopoeial quantitative concentration.
Do not combine class and regression subsets as independent populations.
Selected feature indices cannot be translated into exact physical wavenumbers without original axis metadata.
